description: Explores a website and drafts its measurement plan: the events, parameters and user properties it should track. Same as `aitd plan --site`. The plan is saved (use its ID as against in finish_audit to check an audit against it) and the events are returned. Uses the AI provider configured on the computer running this server (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY) and takes a few minutes. To see what the site sends today, run an audit instead.

site.description: The site to plan, e.g. https://www.example.com/

topic.description: Limit the plan to one kind of event: custom-events, ecommerce, forms, consent. Default: the whole plan.

name: make_plan
title: Draft a tracking plan
